properties.title: M7.5 Venezuela Earthquake
properties.summary: Twin M7.5+M7.2 earthquakes June 24. 920+ killed, 50,000 missing. La Guaira hardest hit. GDACS Red.

properties.title: M7.2 Venezuela Earthquake
properties.summary: Second major quake in twin sequence. Caracas, Carabobo, Miranda affected. Airport closed.

properties.title: M6.5 Philippines (Sarangani)
properties.summary: M6.5 at 42km depth near Sarangani, Philippines. GDACS Orange. 40,000 in MMI>=VII.

properties.title: M6.9 Japan
properties.summary: M6.9 at 50km depth June 24. 80,000 in MMI>=VII.

properties.title: Crimea Emergency Declared
properties.summary: Ukraine drone strikes on power infrastructure force Russian-installed authorities to declare emergency. Kerch Bridge closed multiple times.

properties.title: S. Slobozhansky/Kharkiv Clashes
properties.summary: Active fighting near Veterynarne, Starytsya, Synelnykove. General Staff report June 25.

properties.title: Kupyansk Direction Clashes
properties.summary: Fighting near Hlushkivka, Kurylivka, Shyykivka, Mala Shapkivka.

properties.title: Sumy Drone Strike
properties.summary: 2 wounded in drone attack on fuel station near Sumy.

properties.title: Chernihiv Border Evacuation Order
properties.summary: Mandatory evacuation of 12 border villages from July 1. ~1,000 residents including 120 children.

properties.title: IDF Strikes Beit Yahoun, Lebanon
properties.summary: Israeli aviation struck Beit Yahoun in Bint Jbeil district. 6 strikes past week targeting southern Lebanon militants.

properties.title: IDF Gaza Strikes
properties.summary: Multiple strikes including Al-Maghazi camp and Al-Nasr neighborhood (Italian complex area).

properties.title: Typhoon Mekkhala
properties.summary: Active typhoon at 133.2E 31.6N (East China Sea). Category tracked by NASA EONET.

properties.title: Tropical Storm Higos
properties.summary: Tropical Storm Higos at 142.9E 36.4N off Japan's Pacific coast.

properties.title: Sudan: SAF Airstrikes on RSF (Blue Nile)
properties.summary: Sudan Armed Forces airstrikes on Rapid Support Forces sites in Blue Nile region, southeast Sudan.

properties.title: Iraq Threatens OPEC Exit
properties.summary: Iraq warns it may leave OPEC if production quota not raised. Oil exports fell from 4.2M bpd to 1.48M bpd due to Strait of Hormuz closure during Iran war.
